notes.title: JURASSIC WORLD EVOLUTION 3 RELEASING 21 OCTOBER
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=6cmEUXCTn8Q;full][/previewyoutube]

Hello Park Managers,

We are excited to announce the next entry in the critically acclaimed Jurassic World Evolution franchise, bringing juvenile dinosaurs, a comprehensive breeding system and modular building to your dinosaur parks for the very first time!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40704806/e279bc0257acffe4c135916e007f9ed398c0e8ec.jpg[/img]

Pre-purchase now and receive the Badlands Pack at launch, including a collection of scenery items inspired by the original Jurassic Park film’s iconic dig site, five scenery blueprints from the Montana Badlands, and an exclusive Badlands ATV skin for the all-new Maintenance Team.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40704806/d83de4b680cdc7b58ad7f895f92fc8a667455fc7.jpg[/img]

Fans looking to expand their parks even further can purchase the Jurassic World Evolution 3: Deluxe Edition, featuring four additional spectacular prehistoric family units — Proceratops, Guanlong, Thanatosdrakon and Concavenator — plus a collection of scenery items inspired by a Clark County Campaign level and an exclusive Las Vegas ATV skin.

Join us very soon for more details and a closer look at some gameplay. 

[h2]Generations of Dinosaurs[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40704806/3f65c832efeacf0aa78bb9896d9775b0c12a8057.jpg[/img]

Jurassic World Evolution 3 pushes the boundaries of dinosaur park simulation, featuring over 80 awe-inspiring prehistoric species to raise, manage and care for. Over 70 of these species can breed and nurture their own family units, each with distinct female, male, and juvenile variants.
Park guests will marvel as these majestic creatures socialise and react to the vibrant world around them, displaying new social interactions and behaviours as pterosaurs land to walk, semi-aquatic dinosaurs head into water to feed, and parents nurture their young after emerging from the nest.

[h2]Creativity Evolved[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40704806/7d521fa6684586ae464348f2694319b0c72d8bb3.jpg[/img]

Powerful new tools provide a level of creative control never before seen in the Jurassic World Evolution series, making it easier than ever to build jaw-dropping dinosaur parks. Effortlessly master intuitive terrain tools to create waterfalls, mountain peaks and vast canyons, use texture brushes to add variety to lush landscapes, and precisely place scenery to craft stunning parks and new attractions down to the finest detail, as you shape the legacy of your prehistoric paradise.
For the first time in the series, cross-platform sharing also lets you showcase and download parks, dinosaur enclosures, and scenery creations in a thriving global community via the Frontier Workshop.

[h2]Epic Globetrotting Campaign[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40704806/e4c3f59485f6d4dc8f5aa737002162d4842df940.jpg[/img]

Jurassic World fans and seasoned park managers alike are invited to dive into the ultimate Jurassic World Evolution campaign. Featuring a sprawling world map, filled with diverse locations like Japan and Hawaii, you will discover varied new challenges across non-linear scenarios spanning a thrilling original narrative. 

Jeff Goldblum reprises his role as the iconic Dr. Ian Malcolm, alongside a cast of new and returning characters who are there to help you balance competing human interests with the delicate integration of dinosaurs into our modern world.

[h2]Control the Chaos[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40704806/743996e4fe40345f98281568d24bae75f5fe3c23.jpg[/img]

Featuring expanded and refined management systems, Jurassic World Evolution 3 introduces new ways to run your park safely and securely. Security cameras and a Maintenance ATV team help to keep threats to your park under control, delivering critical repairs and streamlining your response to escaped dinosaurs.

Between the moments of chaos, explore new ways to entertain your guests, including attractions which will allow them to get up close and personal to your dinosaurs or experience your park from a bird’s eye view.

[h2]Let Your Creativity Roar this October[/h2]
Jurassic World Evolution 3 will be arriving on 21 October. Pre-purchase now to unlock the Badlands Pack  at launch, including unique in-game items, blueprints and an ATV Maintenance Team skin.
To stay up to date on the latest information about Jurassic World Evolution 3, follow our social channels, subscribe to the newsletter and keep a close eye on our website.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2958130/
